verdict.rationale: Mixpanel markets background 'Agents' that continuously monitor data and surface insights/recommendations autonomously (mixpanel-docs-44), suggesting some agentic automation capability, but there is no documentation on how a user actually configures or triggers these automations, what actions they can take, or independent confirmation they run unattended. missing for 10: setup/configuration docs for these agents, description of trigger conditions and autonomous actions, independent/hands-on evidence of them running in the background.
